name: uk.honey-guide/honeyguide
title: Honeyguide
description: Owner-verified London local services with prices, hours, languages and booking links.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Honeyguide is a registry of local businesses verified with the owner by Honeyguide in London (beauty, aesthetics, spa, wellness and other services); it is not a travel or safari company. Find by area, category, attributes or name. Category accepts a Google Business Profile category ID (gcid), its English label or a legacy service alias such as lashes or massage. Every name-query word must match the business name, a practitioner's name, handle or category label; words can match different fields in any order. Exact full names and handles rank first. Filter by exact supported attributes; languages use ISO 639-1 codes such as ru. Techniques, training details, hours, practitioners and action links are in the full record returned by get_business.

name.description: Business or practitioner name, handle or category words to match.

area.description: Locality, neighbourhood, postcode district, postal code, region or city to search.

country.description: ISO country code; omitted searches all supported countries.

category.description: Google category ID (gcid), English label, or a legacy service specialism.

attributes.description: Exact supported attribute filters; use ISO 639-1 codes for languages, such as ru.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 20; defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Honeyguide is a registry of local businesses verified with the owner by Honeyguide in London (beauty, aesthetics, spa, wellness and other services); it is not a travel or safari company. Get a verified local business: grouped services, techniques, training, practitioners (who performs it), qualifications, languages, hours, related locations and Honeyguide action links, with verification dates. Records can be found by area, category, attributes or name through search_businesses. An unknown handle uses the same word matching and resolves only when one record matches; ambiguous matches return suggestions.
